name: Imp

traits.name: Shapechanger.
traits.text: The imp can use its action to polymorph into a beast form that resembles a rat (speed 20 ft.) or a raven (speed 10 ft., fly 50 ft.), or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except for the speed changes listed.

actions.name: Sting.
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and DC 11 CON save or 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Invisibility.
actions.text: The imp magically turns invisible until it attacks or its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell).
